Total number of questions — 20
Condition of railway yards and
washing lines
†*141. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the condition of the railway
yards and washing lines located in Delhi
has so much deteriorated that any serious
mishap may occur there at any time;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
employees working there have been
demanding for repairs for the last five years;
(c) if so, the action taken, so far, by
Government for improvement in the
condition; and
(d) by when, reconstruction work of
the buildings of the railway yards and
washing lines would be completed?
Approval of dangerous projects and
industries
†*142. SHRIMATI KUM KUM
RAI: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
last two years Government have given
clearance to such type of projects and
industries which are very dangerous from
environmental point of view; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Clinical trials by multinational
companies
*143. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) what is Government's policy
regarding clinical trials being conducted by
multinational companies in the country;
(b) the steps taken by Government for
regulating such clinical trials;
(c) whether Government have any
mechanism to monitor/regulate such
medical trials;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

46
Introduction of trains running 100
Km. per hour
*144. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to introduce trains in Andhra
Pradesh which run at 100 Km. per hour;
(b) if so, whether Government have
identified any routes for this purpose;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have
conducted any trial before introducing these
trains;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) the time-frame set to introduce these
trains; and
(g) the details of extra expenditure likely
to be incurred for this purpose?
Ban on smoking scenes in films and
TV serials
*145. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have imposed
a ban on smoking scenes in films and
Television serials with effect from
2nd October, 2005;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reaction of film industry, if any,
received by Government; and
(d) how Government propose to tackle
foreign films having smoking scenes released
in theatres?
Crops under NCIS
*146. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the names and details of the crops
which are presently covered under the
National Crop Insurance Scheme;
(b) the names and details of those new
crops which are presently under
consideration for being covered under the
scheme;
(c) whether the scheme is being
implemented in the whole country;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor;
(f) the total number of farmers in the
country, and out of them, the total number
of farmers who have got the benefits of the
scheme during the last three years,
year-wise and State-wise;
(g) whether any target was fixed for the
coverage under the Scheme during
2005-2006; and
(h) if so, the target achieved upto date?
Funds for agricultural research
*147.SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the funds allocated during each of
the last three years for agricultural research,
State-wise;
(b) the achievements made in regard to
higher productivity in the field of agriculture
as a result of these researches;
(c) whether any high-yielding varieties
of paddy and wheat were produced during
these years;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken/being taken to popularize the same
among the farmers;
(e) whether it is a fact that per-hectare
productivity of wheat and paddy is very
low when compared to other countries

47
particularly the western countries and the
far east; and
(f) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps proposed to be taken thereon?

vessels in EEZ

implementing a policy to allow imported
deep sea fishing vessels on deferred
payments to fish in our EEZ;
(b) if so, the number of such trawlers
which fished in 2003-04 and 2004-05;

Achieving growth target for
agriculture sector
1045. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether taking note of the fact that
agriculture sector had not kept up with the
pace required in the last decade, the Prime
Minister has set a 3-4% growth target for
agriculture;
(b) whether the P.M. also referred the
recommendations of Vaidyanathan Task
Force that went into problem of co-
operatives;
(c) the other steps suggested in regard
to agriculture and action proposed to be
taken;
(d) whether the Ministry has initiated
its efforts to achieve growth rate of 4% as
envisaged by the P.M.; and
(e) if so, the steps being considered in
this regard?
Research on agricultural production
1046. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any periodic research in
Agriculture has been conducted to increase
agricultural production in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any survey has been under
taken to monitor the impact of these
researches on agricultural production; and
(d) if so, the outcome thereof?

SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are going to constitute an Agriculture
Coordination Committee;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

 Assistance for dairy development to
M.P.
†1048. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of proposals that have
been received by Government from the
Madhya Pradesh Government under
Consolidated Dairy Development Plan;
(b) the action being taken on those
proposals;
(c) by when the approval will be granted
to those proposals; and
(d) the details of the objectives and
targets set by Government under
Consolidated Dairy Development Plan;
State-wise?
Survey of debt burden on marginal
and poor farmers
1049. DR.GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any survey of debt burden
on two categories of farmers, namely,
marginal and poor, in the country, has been
done;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) how much annual average interest
the farmers have to pay on their debt;
(e) how average annual income of those
farmers compares with their debt burden
and average annual interest they have to
pay;
(f) whether the debt burden on poor
and marginal farmers is increasing and
sourcing of their income decreasing day by
day; and
(g) what conclusions Government have
drawn from the above statistics, regarding
the debt scenario and financial plight of a
poor farmer?
Improving yield and productivity
1050. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that nearly 600
million individuals are engaged in farming
and over 80% of them belong to small and
marginal farmer categories;
(b) whether there is any special package
for small and marginal farmers to upgrade
them from the said category and reduce the
category of small and marginal farmers;
(c) whether despite all technological
applications and practices, the yield per
acre is much less of what can be  achieved,
if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether there will be an integrated
approach to improve the yield and
productivity?
Boosting banana production
1051. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
boost production of bananas both for
domestic consumption and exports;
(b) the current position of the country
in banana production and export; and

to be evolved for boosting production of
bananas in various regions including Orissa?
